title: Contents of the member outlines of one plan sheet
description: Output of the read-only `harness contents <work_dir> <file> --sheet ID --outline-layer L [L ...] --circle-layer L [L ...] [--max-long N] [--marks REGEX] [--mark-radius R] [--dims] [--detail] [--max N] [--tol T] [--input-dir DIR]` (stdout, nothing written): for each closed outline of the outline layers on one sheet (a pile cap, a column stub) its size, how many symbols (pile circles, one per unique centre) lie inside it, its marks and its position against the sheet's grid axes. Built on `harness geometry`: the same items, ids, effective layers and world coordinates. Values are in the drawing's units as stored: nothing is converted (see `units`).

file.description: Inventory path of the drawing, relative to the input folder.

max_long.description: Outlines with a longer long side are dropped (frames). As used: the --max-long value, else 20 m in the answered, else the declared unit, else 20000.

marks.description: Regular expression a mark text must fully match; null = no marks.

mark_radius.description: As used: the --mark-radius value, else 3 m in the answered, else the declared unit, else 3000.

tol.description: As used: the --tol value, else geometry's default (1 mm in the answered, else the declared unit, else 1.0 with a warning).

dims.description: Only with --dims (absent otherwise, so documents saved before the flag stay valid): the printed dimensions are attached (`printed_dims`, `dims`).

declared.description: The unit the header declares; null when none.

answered.description: The unit of the file's active units_confirm_all answer; null when not answered.

converted.description: Always false: every value is as stored in the drawing.

summary.description: Every outline (not capped by max), grouped by layer, size (rounded to tol) and symbols inside; by count desc. The marks of the group are shown, never propagated to outlines that hold none.

marks_seen.description: Mark text to the number of outlines of the group holding it (an outline counts once per text).

unmarked.description: Outlines of the group with no mark assigned.

invisible.description: Outlines of the group that carry the invisible flag (group 60) on all their copies: used, but not drawn.

printed_dims.description: Only with --dims: the outlines of the group by what their attached dimensions print. `none`: nothing attached (also a non-rectangle); `disagree`: at least one printed value differs from the drawn side; else `agree`. `values`: each (side, printed value rounded to tol) with the number of outlines of the group that carry it (an outline counts once per pair), by side then value.

total.description: Unique symbol centres (concentric circles are one).

inside.description: Symbols inside at least one kept outline.

groups.description: Symbols by the set of circle diameters drawn at their centre.

outlines_total.description: Kept outlines, before the cap on `outlines`.

marks_unassigned.description: Matching, usable mark entries with no outline within the mark radius. Empty without --marks.

position.description: The stored position of the entry (not the measured middle).

marks_ambiguous.description: Matching mark entries assigned to none: inside two outlines that do not hold each other, or outside every outline with a runner-up nearly as close (d2 - d1 <= max(tol, 0.25 x d2)), within the radius. Empty without --marks.

outlines.description: Ids of the outlines it could belong to.

symbols_outside.description: Only with --detail: the symbols inside no kept outline.

dims.description: Only with --dims: what became of the DIMENSIONs of the sheet (any layer, hidden layers dropped). They add up: on_sheet = attached + ambiguous + unusable + not_linear + the usable linear ones that reach no outline.

on_sheet.description: Every DIMENSION on the sheet, block content placed by its INSERT counted per placement.

attached.description: Attached to one outline (the `printed_dims` rows of all outlines, even past the cap on `outlines`).

ambiguous.description: Two outlines fitted it equally well (same kind, gaps within tol): attached to neither.

unusable.description: Linear, but with no usable printed number or direction: an error row, a value not compared, a text that is no number or is blocked by the legacy-font gate, a suppressed text, a DIMLFAC that is not positive, or a scaled INSERT, or a rotated one whose dimension stores no angle (group 50) and whose definition points lie on one line.

not_linear.description: Not dimtype 0 or 1 (angular, radial, diameter, ordinate).

distance.description: From the middle of the text to the outline ring; 0 when inside or on the ring. The middle is the centre of the text box of the text index (`sheets.text_box`: ESTIMATED width 0.7 x height x characters, the TEXT alignment or MTEXT attachment, rotation and line count taken into account; a text midpoint or a block position is the point itself). A MULTILEADER mark is measured from its text, not from the arrow: the text index has no leader vertices.

angle.description: Direction of the long side in degrees, [0, 180); null for a non-rectangle.

symbols.description: Unique symbols whose centre is inside the drawn ring, arcs included (boundary within tol counts).

invisible.description: True when every copy of the outline carries the invisible flag (group 60): it is used but not drawn; one warning counts such outlines and symbols.

marks.description: The matching entries whose innermost holding outline, else whose one nearest outline within the radius, is this one; nearest first; usually 0 or 1.

axes.description: One entry per family of each grid group of the sheet whose bbox strictly contains the outline centre (same space); an outline in several groups has entries for each, one in none has none (a warning counts them).

group_id.description: The grid group of grids.json the entry comes from.

label.description: Label of the nearest LABELLED axis of the family; null when the family has no labelled axis. Axes equally near (within tol) give the lower position. An axis is placed at its line midpoint.

offset.description: Outline centre minus that axis, along the family normal (minus the nearest unlabelled axis when the family has no labelled one).

nearest_unlabelled_offset.description: Outline centre minus the nearest unlabelled axis (an axis without a label, or a line of the family's unlabelled_lines in the grids document), only when that axis is nearer than the labelled one; else null. Such a line never sets label or offset, and is not read in a family without a labelled axis.

printed_dims.description: Only with --dims: the linear dimensions attached to the outline, by side, printed value, handle. Empty when none reaches it, and for a non-rectangle.

printed_dim.description: One dimension attached to a rectangular outline: it measures along the `side` of the outline (within 1 degree) and lies within the mark radius of it. `how`: `edges` (its two ends on the two edges across that side, within tol) or `centred` (neither end on an edge, centred on the side, the longer of dimension and side at most twice the shorter; not attached when both ends lie on symbol centres inside the outline, a pile spacing, unless the pile layer was not passed as `--circle-layer`, then it may still attach `centred`). `agrees`: |printed - side x DIMLFAC| <= tol x DIMLFAC.

handle.description: Handle of the DIMENSION; null for block content (a placement of the definition) or when the file's handles are not reliable.

entry_id.description: Id of the dimension's text-index entry when its text is typed; null for a measured or suppressed text.

text.description: The raw text of the dimension as stored (empty or `<>`: the measured value).

printed.description: The number it prints, in drawing units: the typed number of an override text, else the measured length x DIMLFAC (rounded to 0.001).

side.description: The outline side it measures along: `long` when parallel to the outline `angle`, else `short`.
